scouting.title: Scouting
scouting.submitFailed: Could not save the observation. Please try again.

field.title: Field, crop and growth stage
field.noGps: GPS unavailable: pick the field from the list
field.suggested: Field picked by GPS (accuracy ~{{accuracy}} m). Change it if this is the wrong field.
field.noFields: No fields found. You can continue without a field.
field.optional: Field, crop and stage are optional: if you are not sure, just tap "Next".

object.title: What are you photographing?
object.lead: Recognition works best on a close-up of one affected leaf.

leaf.frame: Frame a single leaf with an affected area and healthy tissue next to it.
leaf.distance: Shoot from 15-30 cm so the lesion fills a noticeable part of the frame.
leaf.light: Soft, diffuse light without hard shadows; do not shoot into the sun.
leaf.extra: Take a separate photo of the underside of the leaf: pests and sporulation often hide there.

ear.frame: Frame the whole ear (cob, head) including its top.
ear.distance: Stand 20-40 cm away so the organ fills most of the frame.
ear.light: Side light, no glare on the grain.
ear.extra: For grain damage add a close-up with the ear opened.

stem.frame: Frame the affected part of the stem and the node below it.
stem.distance: Shoot from 15-25 cm with the stem along the diagonal of the frame.
stem.extra: If possible, add a separate photo of the stem base and root collar.

fruit.frame: Frame one whole fruit or pod with the lesion in the center.
fruit.light: Light without glare on the surface.
fruit.extra: Add a photo of a cross-section or the back side of the fruit.

pest.frame: Keep the pest centered and in focus; show the damage next to it if you can.
pest.distance: As close as focus allows (5-10 cm); the pest should fill at least a quarter of the frame.
pest.light: Bright diffuse light, no shadow from your hand or phone.
pest.extra: Place the 5 cm scale card next to it so the size and stage can be estimated.

field.frame: Show the general view of the area: crop rows and the edge of the affected patch.
field.distance: Shoot from standing height with the horizon in the upper third of the frame.
field.light: Avoid backlight; clear weather is best.
field.extra: Add a close-up of the patch and a photo of a healthy area for comparison.

photos.title: Photos (1-{{max}})
photos.scaleMarker: A 5 cm scale card is in the photo

angles.1: Photo 1: close-up of one affected leaf (or organ), lesion in the center filling most of the frame.
angles.2: Photo 2: another close-up of the damage, from another side or on another plant. 2-3 photos give a more accurate diagnosis.
angles.3: Photo 3: a different angle, for example the underside of the leaf or the whole plant.

quality.unassessed: The photo quality could not be checked. Make sure it is sharp and well lit.
quality.unspecified: The photo quality is not sufficient for an accurate diagnosis.
quality.retake: The diagnosis from this photo may be inaccurate. Tap "Retake" to shoot it again.

note.title: Note
note.placeholder: What you noticed: where, on which plants, how many
note.micDenied: Microphone access is denied. Allow it in the browser settings.
note.optional: Optional. Voice is faster when you wear gloves.
